content.title: Plan and publish sitting availability
content.description: A preceptor creates weekly sitting slots with date and AM/PM start time in their own timezone, adjustable duration and capacity, and either all-linked or selected-Abhyasi visibility, can copy last week's plan or add a later slot, and publishes availability with batched announcements for newly visible slots; the owner clarified that duration must be 5–240 minutes and capacity 1–50, with out-of-range values rejected by a validation error.
content.summary: Schedule and announce weekly sitting slots.
content.value: Replaces manual calendar coordination and announces available sittings efficiently.
criteria: Slot dates and AM/PM start times are entered in the preceptor's own timezone; times are stored in UTC.
Slot duration defaults to 45 minutes and is changeable per slot.
Slot capacity defaults to 1 and may exceed 1 for group sittings.
Visibility defaults to all linked Abhyasis, or can be restricted to specifically chosen Abhyasis.
The preceptor can copy the previous week's plan into the current week.
Publishing sends one batched email per eligible Abhyasi listing all newly visible slots, while a single slot added later sends its own announcement.
